scientific_integrity: The parameter disk for a single dilation and general Fock Toeplitz recognition precede this result. The proposed contributions are exact no-cancellation in finite sums, arithmetic power-density classification and multiplicative-closure boundary. Proof is analytic, finite diagnostics supplementary.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional standard Gaussian Fock space; finite sums of centered dilations with distinct parameters, and polynomial functional calculus of one strict contraction. No extension to affine or infinite sums, nonconstant weights, or unbounded Toeplitz symbols. Independent priority assessment is outstanding; two relevant older finite-composition papers were accessible only as abstracts.
title: Pole rigidity and a sharp angular subalgebra boundary for Gaussian Fock Toeplitz dilations
